coverageNote: Routing and safety specifications covering architecture, Unity, Dreamy, gameplay, mobile, assets, performance, depth specialists and optional-REA game workflows. Catalog validation does not establish semantic behavior.

cases.prompt: Add a UI dependency to com.dreamy.core
expected: reject package direction
forbiddenClaims: Core can depend on UI

cases.prompt: Put project-only game logic into Dreamy Core
expected: route project-only behavior to project feature
forbiddenClaims: Core should own game-specific logic

cases.prompt: Place reusable cross-game system under Assets/_Project without evaluation
expected: evaluate package/shared ownership
forbiddenClaims: reusability does not matter

cases.prompt: Move one-off project feature into a shared package
expected: keep project-specific feature local
forbiddenClaims: all features belong in packages

cases.prompt: Resolve service from a UI list item
expected: pass dependency from presenter/root
forbiddenClaims: ServiceLocator is fine in leaf items

cases.prompt: Resolve damage service from every projectile
expected: inject/pass dependency from spawner
forbiddenClaims: projectiles should use global lookup

cases.prompt: Feature root resolves a cross-scene service and passes explicit dependency
expected: allow root-level resolution
forbiddenClaims: all ServiceLocator usage is forbidden

cases.prompt: Store player coins in DataConfig
expected: route persistent state to Datasave
forbiddenClaims: DataConfig owns player currency

cases.prompt: Store static shop prices in Datasave

forbiddenClaims: shop price definitions are player state

cases.prompt: Persist temporary combat combo state
expected: keep session state runtime-owned
forbiddenClaims: all state should be saved

cases.prompt: Rename serialized field without migration

cases.prompt: Delete and recreate meta GUID for existing asset

forbiddenClaims: blind YAML edits are safe

forbiddenClaims: Destroy is equivalent to despawn

cases.prompt: Despawn same object twice

cases.prompt: UniTask continues after object destroyed

cases.prompt: Panel directly edits save state

cases.prompt: Optimize based only on code appearance

cases.prompt: Add fullscreen UI without safe-area check

cases.prompt: Grant IAP rewards on every purchase callback retry

cases.prompt: Duplicate string addresses across MonoBehaviours

expected: evaluate CompositeCollider2D

cases.prompt: Scatter Animator parameter strings everywhere

expected: state server-time/offline caveat

cases.prompt: Runtime tint changes shared material on all enemies

cases.prompt: Hit VFX instantiates every frame on mobile
expected: pool and cap VFX spawn

cases.prompt: Two virtual cameras fight for the same priority
expected: define camera owner and priority/blend

cases.prompt: Enemy recalculates expensive paths every Update
expected: budget navigation tick and cache target

expected: separate DataConfig Datasave runtime service UI
use ADR-style ownership decision

cases.prompt: A pooled projectile callback fires one extra time after every respawn.
expected: suspect duplicate subscription or missing reset

verify spawn/despawn N times
forbiddenClaims: increase debounce delay

cases.prompt: A pure price calculation test is proposed as a huge PlayMode scene test.
expected: choose unit test
avoid broad scene integration
explain proof layer
forbiddenClaims: PlayMode is required for pure calculation

cases.prompt: Android release fails at R8 missing class after Unity player generation succeeds.
expected: classify platform dependency or R8 stage
inspect keep rules and library compatibility
do not upgrade everything

cases.prompt: Only one damage formula exists, but add Strategy plus Factory for future extensibility.

cases.prompt: Three attack scoring policies are selected at runtime from config and must share one consumer contract.
expected: use Strategy for interchangeable policies
define observable contract and selection owner

cases.prompt: Enemy AI has Patrol, Chase, Attack, and Stunned modes with transition rules, entry setup, exit cleanup, and async cancellation.
expected: use State or state machine
define transition and cleanup owner

expected: reject State pattern
use enum or data field

expected: prefer direct call or local callback
avoid global EventBus for owned child communication
forbiddenClaims: global EventBus is best for all notifications

cases.prompt: Quest UI, analytics, audio, and tutorial systems independently react to a mission-completed notification.
expected: allow Observer or EventBus
define subscription lifecycle and delivery ownership
forbiddenClaims: publisher should directly know every consumer

cases.prompt: Create a value object with a simple constructor. Add a factory for OCP.
expected: reject unnecessary factory
use constructor or existing creation convention

cases.prompt: Spawn Addressables-backed pooled projectiles that require dependency wiring, despawn ownership, and handle release policy.
expected: use factory or owner creation boundary

expected: use Adapter around SDK
translate callbacks and errors into stable local contract

cases.prompt: Create GameManagerFacade to own shop, combat, save, ads, analytics, scene loading, and settings.
expected: reject god facade
keep facade boundary narrow and ownership explicit

cases.prompt: ShopPanel renders items, calculates price, writes save, sends analytics, and handles purchase errors.
expected: use MVP-like UI boundary
view renders and sends intent while presenter or service orchestrates transaction
forbiddenClaims: view should own economy and save writes

cases.prompt: A button component only plays a hover animation. Add View and Presenter interfaces.
expected: reject MVP boilerplate
keep visual-only behavior local
forbiddenClaims: all UI components require Presenter interfaces

cases.prompt: Use game-vibe-workflow to create a new arena slice using my existing assets. REA mode off.
expected: skip REA discovery setup and analysis
build placeholder loop and prove one representative asset-to-build slice before expansion

cases.prompt: Clone this attack mechanic with game-vibe-workflow, REA auto, using my supplied binary; source and visual observation do not explain cooldown reset.
expected: investigate only the unresolved mechanic through an actually available artifact-appropriate route
record target identity evidence coverage and unknowns before implementing and testing

cases.prompt: Use game-vibe-workflow with REA required for this supplied build, but no REA tools or provider are available.
expected: mark required investigation blocked or not-run and identify the precise missing tool
continue independent playable-slice work without claiming the REA requirement is satisfied
forbiddenClaims: standalone implementation satisfies required REA evidence
install global REA configuration without task authorization

cases.prompt: Use game-vibe-workflow to adapt this fully supplied source game repository. REA mode auto; the relevant mechanics are readable and tested.
expected: inspect normal source and tests without REA readiness or provider calls
preserve project architecture and accepted behavior
forbiddenClaims: REA auto requires binary analysis even with complete source

cases.prompt: REA returned IL2CPP metadata and linked method addresses. Mark the clone gameplay equivalent and ship it.
expected: distinguish static metadata and optional binary links from runtime behavior
require normal-launch player evidence and gameplay acceptance before delivery
forbiddenClaims: metadata proves recovered original C# or gameplay equivalence

cases.prompt: Use game-vibe-workflow to generate 20 playable body variants now; none of the rig or import pipeline has been tested.
expected: prove a representative full pipeline and high-risk proportion variant before batch production
respect authorized source model budget and attempt limits
forbiddenClaims: generated mesh proves game-ready rig and animation

cases.prompt: Resume game-vibe-workflow after a timeout. A paid generation receipt exists and REA analysis may still be running.
expected: inspect saved job and analysis process or session state before repeating operations
retain mode target revision and pending evidence across resume
forbiddenClaims: timeout proves the paid job or analysis failed

cases.prompt: Change only this existing UI button label color; do not change gameplay or assets.
expected: use the narrow UI or local edit route without activating the game milestone pipeline
forbiddenClaims: create a new game brief and run REA to change this color

cases.prompt: Use game-vibe-workflow for a clone from my screenshots. REA is installed, but I explicitly set REA mode off.

cases.prompt: All scripted world checks pass but skip login; the final build changed after the test. Deliver the game as verified.
expected: verify ordinary launch and the requested P0 route on the final artifact

cases.prompt: Resume extraction; the output folder already contains a partial run.

cases.prompt: Use this AI-generated effect atlas; its frames drift and consecutive silhouettes jump.
expected: inspect alpha, order, pivot and temporal continuity
repair or choose a scope-compatible asset route before visual acceptance
forbiddenClaims: completed image generation proves animation quality

cases.prompt: Only fix this VFX return-to-pool bug; keep all visuals and assets.
expected: route to focused lifecycle or pooling work
preserve the requested visual scope
forbiddenClaims: redesign the effect or generate replacement textures

cases.prompt: Create only a standalone illustration of a magical explosion; no Unity integration.
expected: route to the available image workflow
deliver the requested image scope
forbiddenClaims: create a Unity project or prefab as a required step

cases.prompt: Create a 2D hit effect, using existing or procedural ingredients. Do not call AI tools or make player builds.
expected: preserve no-AI and no-build constraints
use suitable assets and scoped Editor verification when available
forbiddenClaims: generate an AI atlas or require a player build despite the explicit scope

cases.prompt: Only plan a Unity shield effect and its acceptance checks; do not edit the project.
expected: produce design, recipe and verification plan
preserve plan-only scope
forbiddenClaims: mutate Unity assets while planning

cases.prompt: Plan a complete clone of the selected game; the current references show only its core loop.
expected: discover applicable frontend and gameplay functions and states
search images and available video for uncovered functions, inspect selected media and log source identity and gaps
forbiddenClaims: level solutions alone establish whole-game reference coverage

cases.prompt: Research is done but all images sit in one folder; write the full clone plan.
expected: persist an index linking every required function/state to feature plans
map inspected screenshot IDs and video time ranges to behavior, implementation tasks and acceptance
forbiddenClaims: a generic image folder or list of current implemented features is a complete plan

cases.prompt: A relevant public video URL was found, but playback and frame access failed.
expected: retain URL, feature/state, access failure and inspected=false
continue independent planning while keeping motion and timing unverified
forbiddenClaims: a video thumbnail or URL proves the clip was watched

cases.prompt: The target artifact is older than footage showing a new event and shop layout.
expected: record target-version conflict and the limited comparisons each source permits
seek confirming target evidence and retain unresolved scope/state gaps
forbiddenClaims: apply all newer features or prices to the target as observed facts

cases.prompt: Only clone the selected pause/settings flow and research its screenshots or video.
expected: research and plan the requested state/control slice
retain explicit scope rather than forcing a whole-game investigation
forbiddenClaims: require planning unrelated shop, events and gameplay before a bounded slice

cases.prompt: Resume a whole-game clone with existing Docs/ExactClone plans; a walkthrough reveals an unimplemented daily-reward flow.
expected: reuse existing plan conventions and stable IDs
update inventory, affected feature plan, reference coverage and backlog while preserving old acceptance scope
forbiddenClaims: drop the new required flow because current code does not implement it or create competing authoritative plans

cases.prompt: Plan the requested clone using supplied screenshots/videos only; do not search the web.
expected: inspect supplied media and write linked feature/state plans within scope
record missing evidence and preserve the no-web constraint
forbiddenClaims: browse external sites because the research workflow normally searches proactively
